points.description: States that a convolutional layer is used, with kernels (filters) that convolve over the input image. Equivalent wording, such as 'convolution layer with filters sliding over the image', earns the mark.

Names the remaining layers of the CNN: an activation layer (ReLU), a pooling layer (max or average), and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax layer. Equivalent wording and naming the layers in any sensible order earn the mark. Naming only some of these layers, or naming them without the fully connected/softmax stage, earns half a mark.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 marks for naming some but not all of the activation, pooling, fully connected and softmax layers, provided the student does not also name the correct convolution layer under P1.
